column1: # Diagnosis input CSV. One *group* per data line.
# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/generate_diagnosis_sw_576.py - 32x18 MCS grid (576 channels).
# IL Test IN half (odd lap). OUT half uses SW1 port swap (see diagnosis_sw_group2.csv).
# Channel label: CH{k} where k = (sw-1)*18 + ch, sw=1..32, ch=1..18.
# (1#1x64 port sw, 2#1x64 port sw+32; same channel on both 1x18 switches.)
#   - Each data line is one logical diagnosis step:
#     The host sends every SW command in order (CR appended automatically),
#     reads one reply line per SW (typically "OK"/"FAIL").
#   - After all SW in the group, the host runs three measure paths (s1/s2/s3), no precheck:
#   - Lines starting with '#' or ';' are comments. The trimmed text after
#     the marker is attached as the *label* of the next data line (used for
#     reporting only; not sent over serial).
#   - UTF-8 BOM on the first line is tolerated.
#   If the log has an older header (e.g. 25-column precheck format), delete or rename output\diagnosis_log.csv once.
